notes: Page states parent Olsen and lists ECR-family sister/similar brands, but establishes no shared-system reuse, so usesStylesOf is null and only this page's own styles are encoded; nothing is imported from any Duromatic-Olsen or ECR-family page. Only style-1 ships, year-only: its year is text-stated (3rd-4th characters) while its month is a 5th-character letter decoded only by a chart image, which is held for the image pass. Styles 2, 3 and 4 are held entire: both their month and year are single letters decoded only by chart images. Style 5 (R-2880) is stated undeterminable on the page. The ANSI/CSA standards-date estimation described on the page is never encoded as a serial rule.

styles.notes: Year-only: page states year as 3rd-4th characters. Month is the 5th-character letter per a chart image only, held for the image pass (not guessed). Character and digit-only counting agree on the year here.
